questions: How many oxidized or etched CsV3Sb5 devices did you make and measure, and how many showed a field-free diode? Table S1 answers this for the ten pristine devices; Devices 11 to 14 are the inversion-broken ones shown.
Why were the others set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: how many zero-field sweeps per condition in total, which field steps in Fig. 4, and were the Ti-doped Devices 15 and 16 also swept at the 0.1 to 0.2 T out-of-plane fields of Fig. 4?

What does the second-best dataset look like? For example, the first and third sweeps of Device 11 at the second oxidation stage (SM p. 2 says only the second showed a diode), and Device 14 next to Device 13.

What is the remanent field of the PPMS and Triton magnets at nominal B = 0, especially after the 1 T field-cooling runs (Figs. S8, S9) and the ±0.2 T sweeps of Fig. 4, and was it measured or nulled? A fine scan of η through zero field, a few mT each way, would show where the sign actually changes.

Could you show histograms of |Ic+| and |Ic−| from many sweeps (say a hundred each) at zero field for Device 13 or 14, and for Ti-doped Device 16, and say whether the two distributions differ in their means?

How was the onset current extracted from dV/dI with a 10 μA AC excitation and 0.2 to 0.5 μA steps (Fig. S3), when the critical currents in Fig. S4 are 17 to 36 μA, and how does η change with a smaller excitation or a different Ic criterion?

Which device is which? The main text calls the Fig. 2 device Device 11 and gives the −30.86% to 17.07% range for Device 12, while the Fig. S3 caption calls Device 12 the Fig. 2 device and those η values appear in Fig. S4, labeled Device 13. How do the thickness, Tc and Ic of Devices 15 and 16 compare with Devices 11 to 14?
